punchline: In Skinner's experiments, the animals fed only some of the time pressed the lever more than the ones fed every time.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal starts with an old Skinner experiment. Some animals got food every time they pressed a lever, others only now and then, unpredictably. The unpredictable group pressed more. Eyal says apps run on the same thing: rewards that may or may not show up. Sometimes it's people noticing you, sometimes it's the next interesting post, sometimes it's the satisfaction of clearing your inbox.
question: Which app do you open most without really needing to, and what are you hoping to find when you do?
